entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. This VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference issue?
I guess you'd call it preference. The whole interface is just... confusing.
I see. I appreciate you clarifying that. Sometimes new technology can have a bit of a learning curve. Could you tell me what part of the interface you've found to be particularly hard to use?
The main screen during a workout. Honestly, I expected more than just a jumble of numbers. I looked through the user manual and it was no help at all.

Ah, that's a very common point of feedback, and I have a great solution for you. That display is actually fully customizable through the VeloFit app. You can change which stats you see, and even how you see them – like using graphs or color zones instead of just numbers. Do you have your phone handy? I can walk you through it.
Fine.
Great. If you open the VeloFit app, go to the 'Devices' tab and select your VeloBand Pulse. From there, you should see an option for 'Display Customization'. Let me know when you see it.
...Okay, I'm there.
Perfect. In that menu, you can drag and drop different data fields. You can choose heart rate zones, power output graphs, cadence charts, whatever is most important for your training. Give it a try.
Oh. I see I can change the main number to a color bar for my heart rate zone. Well, that's... actually useful.
Exactly! It's designed so you can get the info you need with just a quick glance. Now that you know how to customize it, does that feel more like what you were hoping for from the device?
I suppose. Would've been nice if the user manual mentioned that instead of just showing pictures. Whatever.

That's excellent feedback, and I will personally pass that suggestion on to our documentation team. And I see here that you're a VeloFit VIP member. To thank you for your loyalty and for your patience with this, I've just added a complimentary three-month extension to your Premium subscription. Hopefully you can use it to explore some of the advanced training plans that pair with the Pulse.
Fine. Thanks, I guess.
You're most welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
